author: Caleb Curry
description: a lot of tech burnout is learning fatigue: you invested years in stuff AI can now generate, and that sunk cost makes it hard to pick up the new way. avoiding the new stuff is a risk too. the fix: 10% of your time on new stuff, 90% getting great at what you already know.
title: you've wasted so much time learning code #coding #programming

author: Caleb Curry
description:
Every few years tech promises something life changing and you're expected to drop everything and learn it. Most of it fizzles out. Here's how I decide what's worth learning, what the bleeding edge tax costs you, and why spending about 10% of your time learning is enough to keep up with AI.

author: Caleb Curry
description:
Giant files make the AI break something every time it touches them. Keep files under ~1,000 lines, and put a ratchet on the old big ones so they can only shrink. Any new file over the limit fails like a compile error.
